title: A Day with a Smart Robot
text:
In the future, many people will have small robots at home. A robot can clean the floor, cook simple meals and remind you about your appointments. Some robots can even talk with you when you feel lonely.

One family in our town already uses a robot named Max. Max helps the children with their homework every evening. His owners say that he is very patient, and he never gets tired. However, the family still prefers to talk to each other at dinner.

questions.text: What can a robot do in the house, according to the first paragraph?
What does Max do for the children?
options: He helps them with their homework

questions.text: How does the family probably feel about Max?
options: They think he is useful but do not depend on him completely
They do not notice him at all

questions.text: Why might the family still prefer to talk to each other at dinner?
options: Because talking with people is more personal than talking with a robot
Because dinner is only for adults

vocabulary.definition: times when you have arranged to meet someone or go somewhere
able to wait calmly without getting angry
tasks that students do at home after school
sad because you are alone and have no friends nearby

paragraph_translations: W przyszłości wiele osób będzie miało w domu małe roboty. Robot może sprzątać podłogę, gotować proste posiłki i przypominać o wizytach. Niektóre roboty potrafią nawet rozmawiać z tobą, gdy czujesz się samotny.

Jedna rodzina w naszym mieście już używa robota o imieniu Max. Max pomaga dzieciom w odrabianiu pracy domowej każdego wieczoru. Jego właściciele mówią, że jest bardzo cierpliwy i nigdy się nie męczy. Mimo to rodzina nadal woli rozmawiać ze sobą podczas kolacji.
